population.region: Fixed broad Southern California rectangle enclosing major SCSN onshore belts and adjacent offshore region; chosen from network geography, not event locations or outcomes.
population.depth_datum: current routine catalogue WGS84 reference ellipsoid
population.magnitude_policy: Agency preferred magnitude, mixed types retained as recorded; no homogenization and no type-based substitution; model excess q=M-4.
population.magnitude_type_policy: Allowed documented preferred SCEDC codes e,w,b,s,l,lr,c,h,d only, finite M; retain recorded code, no homogenization/substitution. Unknown nonempty code failsclosed for native schema adjudication before protected release; no outcome-driven eligibilitychange.
population.review_status: Routine preferred solutions, not guaranteed individually reviewed; no review-status filter.
population.coordinates: Routine SCEDC coordinates, not separately relocated product. Retain serialized precision; precision is not location accuracy.
population.boundary: Closed latitude, longitude and depth support; event magnitude >=4; time windows [start,end). On internal edges use northern/eastern cell; uppermost edges included in final cell.

source.product: Routine preferred catalogue; source adapter/acquisition manifest owned by catalogue manager
source.historical_asof: Not reconstructed. All predictor and target origin times, coordinates, magnitudes, IDs and merges use one pinned revised snapshot; future revisions may have informed them. Every result labeled revised-catalogue hindsight external retrospective validation.

era.rationale: 1981 marks modern digital/CUSP-era archive and primary source regional-average completeness evidence; five-year unscored warmup then 25 years scored development. Three predeclared nonoverlapping five-year tests provide separate calendar exposures. End 2026-01-01 leaves substantial catalogue revision latency without inspecting recent rows.
era.time_coordinate: UTC timestamps parsed as Python datetime, civil/POSIX elapsed seconds excluding leap-second insertions, divided by86400 since1981-01-01; x=2*t/T0-1; no leap-second table. Reject serialized second60 for explicit schema handling, never silently clamp.

history.target_and_parent_population: Same fixed region/depth/type/M>=4 population. No outside-domain or subthreshold parent imports.
history.outside_domain_limitation: Forecasts condition on recorded within-domain M>=4 history. Missing boundary/subthreshold triggering is absorbed imperfectly by background; no complete physical triggering interpretation.
history.warmup: 1981..1986 parents retained but no targets scored in warmup. Earliest available history truncated at1981; no equilibrium/pre1981 correction.
history.within_test: Strictly earlier targets may become predictable parents within same window; no parameter/background updates until next declared origin. Revised-vintage hindsight applies to all rows.
history.rolling: At2016 and2021, former test rows may enter expanding scored training under frozen rules; developers must not inspect them before G5. Firstfold feasibility only uses pre2011 data.
history.ties: DistinctIDs at same exact source timestamp retained; strict origin_time_parent<origin_time_target, no ordering/jitter inside tiedbatch; IDsort reproducibility only. Preserve actual serialized precision; optional integer origin_time_us enables exact timestamp audit. Engine accepts nondecreasing times and excludes lag<=0.

completeness.threshold_selection: Fixed M>=4 before rows: conservative margin over regional-average source evidence, plus a computational/sample compromise versus M3.5/M5. No threshold adaptation.
completeness.source_evidence: Hutton, Woessner & Hauksson2010 reports average ML completeness ~1.8 since1981; this is not uniform completeness in this rectangle or for every sequence/magnitude convention.
completeness.diagnostic_population: Separate local training-only diagnostic extraction preferred M>=2 with same time/region/depth/type filters; never model parents or targets.

diagnostic_rule.strata: Six fixed five-year bins [1981,1986),...,[2006,2011) crossed three latitude zones; earliest G2 only. For later expanding folds repeat same five-year strata through origin inside frozen evaluator.
diagnostic_rule.bins: Edges2.0,2.1,...,8.5; [left,right), final8.5 value included in last bin. Values>8.5 recorded overflow and cause fail-closed review; below2 excluded; nonfinite/missing magnitude excluded and counted.
diagnostic_rule.mode: Choose largest-magnitude bin among all tied maximum-count bins; corrected modal diagnostic = bin midpoint +0.5.
diagnostic_rule.admit_if: Every stratum has >=100 events, no overflow/schema error, and corrected modal diagnostic<=4.0; otherwise ineligible; no redesign of threshold, dates, region or strata within this registration.

completeness.limitation: Histogram screen is a diagnostic, not a completeness estimator with guaranteed coverage. It can miss short post-mainshock losses, magnitude heterogeneity and spatial network weaknesses. Preserve this uncertainty even after passing.

spatial.measure: dxdy=spherical surface area km^2; Euclidean isotropy in this projection only
spatial.parent_coordinates: actual projected event positions in BOTH families; never snap parents to centers
spatial.cell_centers: midpoints of projected rectangular cell bounds
spatial.eligibility: Earliest scored training >=180 targets total and >=30 per latitude zone; later folds apply same fixed check only inside frozen harness. No cell minimum, no geometry adaptation.
spatial.normalization_checks: F>0, Z>0, sum nine F equals whole rectangle F, F_domain<pi*sigma^2; no clipping negative/invalid integrals
